cases.sql: CREATE TABLE bitwise_inputs(id integer PRIMARY KEY, s smallint, i integer, b bigint)
SELECT id, s & 3::smallint AS band, s | 3::smallint AS bor, s # 3::smallint AS bxor, ~s AS bnot FROM bitwise_inputs ORDER BY id
SELECT id, c.n, s << c.n AS left_shift, s >> c.n AS right_shift FROM bitwise_inputs CROSS JOIN (VALUES (-1), (0), (15), (16), (31), (32), (63), (64)) c(n) ORDER BY id, c.n
SELECT id, i & 3::integer AS band, i | 3::integer AS bor, i # 3::integer AS bxor, ~i AS bnot FROM bitwise_inputs ORDER BY id
SELECT id, c.n, i << c.n AS left_shift, i >> c.n AS right_shift FROM bitwise_inputs CROSS JOIN (VALUES (-1), (0), (15), (16), (31), (32), (63), (64)) c(n) ORDER BY id, c.n
SELECT id, b & 3::bigint AS band, b | 3::bigint AS bor, b # 3::bigint AS bxor, ~b AS bnot FROM bitwise_inputs ORDER BY id
SELECT id, c.n, b << c.n AS left_shift, b >> c.n AS right_shift FROM bitwise_inputs CROSS JOIN (VALUES (-1), (0), (15), (16), (31), (32), (63), (64)) c(n) ORDER BY id, c.n
SELECT id, s & i AS si, i # b AS ib, s | b AS sb FROM bitwise_inputs ORDER BY id
CREATE VIEW bitwise_view AS SELECT id, s & 3::smallint AS band, ~(i | 4) AS bnot, (b # 1) << 2 AS shifted, i + (i >> 3) AS precedence FROM bitwise_inputs
SELECT * FROM bitwise_view ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM bitwise_view WHERE id IN (1, 2, 5) ORDER BY id
CREATE VIEW bitwise_prefix_view AS SELECT id, ~(i | 4) AS inverse, ~(~i) AS nested, +(i | 4) AS positive, @(i | 4) AS absolute, i & (i % 4) AS mixed FROM bitwise_inputs
SELECT * FROM bitwise_prefix_view ORDER BY id
CREATE VIEW bitwise_mixed_view AS SELECT s & i AS si, i | b AS ib, ~b AS inverse, b % i AS remainder, |/i AS root FROM bitwise_inputs WHERE id = 1
CREATE TABLE bitwise_generated(id integer PRIMARY KEY, n integer DEFAULT (7 & 3), mask integer GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((n | 8) # 2) STORED, CHECK ((n & 1) = 1))
INSERT INTO bitwise_generated(id) VALUES (1), (2) RETURNING id, n, mask
SELECT id FROM bitwise_inputs WHERE (i & 3) = 1 ORDER BY id
SELECT id, n, mask FROM bitwise_generated ORDER BY id
UPDATE bitwise_generated SET n = n | 4 WHERE id = 2 RETURNING id, n, mask
SELECT id, n, mask FROM bitwise_generated ORDER BY id
SELECT pg_get_constraintdef(oid) AS definition FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'bitwise_generated'::regclass AND contype = 'c'
UPDATE bitwise_inputs SET i = i # 3 WHERE id = 1 RETURNING id, i
SELECT i FROM bitwise_inputs WHERE id = 1
CREATE DOMAIN bitwise_positive AS integer CHECK(VALUE > 0)
PREPARE bitwise_mixed (smallint, integer, bigint) AS SELECT $1 & $2 AS a, $2 # $3 AS b, ~($1 | $3) AS c, $1 << $2 AS d
PREPARE bitwise_null (integer) AS SELECT $1 & nextval('bitwise_effect')::integer AS value
PREPARE bitwise_unknown AS SELECT $1 & 3 AS mask, 1::smallint << $2 AS shifted
INSERT INTO bitwise_generated(id) VALUES (4) RETURNING id,n,mask
